comments.body: Sharing ACLs mirror dashboard visibility; writing tests for guest role denial.

content.text: Sharing ACLs mirror dashboard visibility; writing tests for guest role denial.
Individuals rearrange dashboards carefully, then teammates rebuild the same layout by hand. Teams want a shared layout object they can apply without copying widget JSON.

Allow power users (dashboard:admin) to save the current layout as a named reusable layout, optionally share it with the workspace. Others can “Apply layout” which clones widget config and queries but not live filter personalization. Version field increments on overwrite.
Acceptance: max 25 shared layouts per workspace, apply is undoable for 30s, and personal drafts stay private until shared.
